commands.assertions: Terminal bytes and scrollback remain intact across reattach, resize is audited, wrong-protocol frames are rejected, revocation closes live channels, and full viewer buffers never block the push path.

assertions: PTY output is opaque and replayed in order after browser transport detach; resize is admitted and audited.
Client-supplied OPEN frames are rejected because session opening is server-owned.
Node disconnect closes existing sessions and clears online/health authority.
Viewer queues are bounded and report non-delivery rather than blocking indefinitely.
limitations: Loss-before-effect, loss-after-effect reconciliation, relay cost/latency, and attached-device grant revocation remain open.
